title: 第5章 瘟疫与战争第6章 面板
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：暮色降临，被弗森派出去安置底下士兵的罗杰在天黑前赶回到了二层小楼。
“说说吧，还剩多少人。”
屋内煤油灯那有些昏暗的灯光照在弗森依旧没有表情的脸上，他本来不是个喜欢板着脸的人，可残酷的现实已经让他很难再流露出笑容。
“全部清点完了，一共还剩一百四十六名士兵，其中只有七十三名是之前第戎卫戍军团的，其他都是临时征召的民兵。”
“现在他们已经全部都住进了枫叶城提供的临时住房内。”
罗杰汇报的声音也有失落，虽然逃亡的时候就知道情况已经很糟糕了，但没想到居然已经到了这种地步。
整整三千人的第戎卫戍军团居然只剩下了七十三人！
他记得明明当时撤出第戎城的时候还有上千人啊！
“只剩下这点了吗……”
弗森即使心里已经有了准备，在听到这个消息的时候还是忍不住心中一痛，这可都是琉璃川家族的底蕴啊，现在却损失的一干二净。
屋里另外坐在角落里的四位骑士在听到这个消息也是同样的眼神黯淡。
或许是被屋内沮丧的情绪给影响了，罗杰忍不住说道：“如果当初琉璃川大公没有率领三大军团前往边境迎击那些海底爬出来的臭虫，或许依靠坚固的城池我们是可以守住的，毕竟那可是整整三万全副武装的战士啊。”
三万名全职士兵，再加上那些征召来的民兵以及负责运送粮草物资的辅兵，整支出征的队伍数量甚至能达到将近十万人。
在这片大陆上，军团虽然已经是最大的独立军事编制了，但军团与军团之间还是有差别的。
一般情况下，负责城池卫戍任务的都是三千人的小军团，而野外征战的则是万人编制的大军团。
当然，也不乏一些领主即使凑不齐那么多全职战士也依旧把自己的部队冠上军团之名。
毕竟这样子说出去威武霸气一些。
“罗杰！
你忘了骑士的守则吗！”
听到罗杰的抱怨，弗森立马厉声呵斥道。
“没有！”
“我不应该在背后抱怨大公所作出的决定，实在是万分抱歉，诸位。”
罗杰瞬间就意识到了自己犯下了大忌。
即使他效忠的对象已经死了，但这不意味着他可以在背后议论琉璃川大公的是非。
这是他作为一个骑士最基本的操守。
弗森用严厉的目光扫视了一眼仅剩的五名骑士，然后缓缓说道：“我知道你们现在很迷茫，也知道你们心中的忐忑。”
“但你们必须要明白，你们曾经宣誓效忠琉璃川大公阁下，即使现在大公阁下已经不幸战死。
但我们琉璃川骑士团依旧要履行我们当年的誓言，琉璃川大公不在了，那我们就要效忠大公阁下的直属后代。”
“如果有机会，则要想尽一切办法夺回第戎城，重铸琉璃川家族的荣耀！”
“听明白了吗？”
弗森说到后面声音骤然放大。
“明白！”
content_en:
: As dusk fell, Roger, who was sent out by Fusen to place the soldiers below, rushed back to the two-story building before dark.
"Tell me how many people are left."
The dim light of the kerosene lamp in the room shone on Fusen's still expressionless face. He was not a person who liked to keep a straight face, but the cruel reality made it difficult for him to smile anymore.
"After all the counting, there are a total of one hundred and forty-six soldiers left. Only seventy-three of them are from the previous Dijon garrison. The rest are temporarily recruited militiamen."
"Now they have all moved into the temporary housing provided by Maple Leaf City."
Roger's voice when reporting was also disappointing. Although he knew the situation was very bad when he fled, he didn't expect it to have reached this point.
There were only seventy-three people left in the Dijon garrison out of a total of three thousand men!
He remembered that there were still thousands of people when they evacuated Dijon City!
"Is this all that's left..."
Even though Fusen was prepared in his heart, he still couldn't help but feel a pain in his heart when he heard the news. This was all the heritage of the Liulicuan family, but now it was completely lost.
The other four knights sitting in the corners of the room also had dim eyes when they heard the news.
Perhaps affected by the depressed mood in the room, Roger couldn't help but said: "If Grand Duke Liulicuan had not led the three legions to the border to fight against the bugs crawling out of the sea, maybe we could have defended the city with a strong city. After all, there were thirty thousand fully armed soldiers."
Thirty thousand full-time soldiers, plus the conscripted militiamen and auxiliary soldiers responsible for transporting food and supplies, the entire expedition team could even reach nearly 100,000 people.
Although the legion is already the largest independent military establishment on this continent, there are still differences between legions.
Under normal circumstances, those responsible for city garrison tasks are small legions of three thousand people, while those who fight in the wild are large legions composed of ten thousand people.
Of course, there are also some lords who still name their troops as legions even if they cannot recruit so many full-time warriors.
After all, it sounds more powerful and domineering when spoken this way.
"Roger!
Have you forgotten the knight's code? "
Hearing Roger's complaint, Ferson immediately snapped.
"No!"
"I shouldn't complain behind the back about the decision made by the Grand Duke. I'm really sorry, everyone."
Roger immediately realized that he had made a big mistake.
Even though the person he was loyal to was dead, it didn't mean that he could discuss the rights and wrongs of Grand Duke Liulicuan behind his back.
This is his most basic conduct as a knight.
Fusen glanced at the remaining five knights with a stern look, and then said slowly: "I know you are confused now, and I also know the anxiety in your hearts."
"But you must understand that you once swore allegiance to His Excellency Grand Duke Liulicuan, even though now His Excellency the Grand Duke has unfortunately died in battle.
But we, the Knights of Liulicuan, still have to fulfill our vows. If the Grand Duke of Liulicuan is no longer here, then we must be loyal to the direct descendants of His Excellency the Grand Duke. "
"If there is a chance, we must do everything possible to recapture Dijon City and rebuild the glory of the Liulicuan family!"
"Do you understand?"
Ferson's voice suddenly became louder after speaking.
"clear!"
